notes: The outcome is visits per 100,000 ED visits, a unitless proportion, so binary/categorical rather than count/rate. Significance of percentage changes is shown with marks; the test behind the Jan-to-Dec changes is not named. Tests are of change over time within each group, not across groups.
view_issues: The table note defines percentage change as month-over-previous-month, but the columns report Jan-to-Dec and 24-month changes. Females 20–39 (27.1%) and Southeast (30.2%) are unmarked despite large changes.
